svg.title: RelayCache: identity-aware cross-step history refresh
svg.desc: Full-depth history refresh is compared with RelayCache. Current masked and identity-changed rows execute all layers; selected unchanged history executes the rotating eight-layer stripe; unselected context retains its KV. After full initialization, saved boundary hidden states supply subsequent stripes. Two history columns illustrate a repeatedly selected unchanged cohort, not a guarantee of persistent membership. Cached context remains readable at all layers. This schematic makes no native-equivalence or measured-speed claim.
